facts.text: I am in the market for a new laptop.
I checked out some laptop options at Best Buy.
I have been using a portable power bank from Mophie a lot lately.
I bought the Mophie portable power bank on February 20th for $39.99 on Amazon.
The Mophie portable power bank was originally $69.99.
I am looking for a laptop around $800-$1200.
I am interested in a laptop with a touchscreen.
I want at least 16GB of RAM.
A sales rep at Best Buy mentioned laptop models with Intel Core i7 processors.
I am interested in the HP Envy x360.
I am interested in the Dell Inspiron 15 5000 2-in-1.
I prefer a laptop with an SSD.
I am not sure if I need a large-capacity SSD.
I want to know whether the laptops have USB-A ports or are mostly USB-C.
I am still deciding between the HP Envy x360 and the Dell Inspiron 15 5000 2-in-1.
I want the laptop to last a full day without needing a charge.
I am concerned about cooling and noise levels for the laptops.
I have had issues with laptops overheating in the past.
I plan to use the laptop in quiet environments like libraries or coffee shops.
I have had issues with laptops having poor viewing angles in the past.

events.text: Bought a Mophie portable power bank on Amazon for $39.99 (originally $69.99)
